versions.provenance: International Myeloma Working Group (IMWG) Revised International Staging System (R-ISS) and Second Revision (R2-ISS); licensed clinical reference.
versions.introduction: Multiple myeloma does NOT use anatomical TNM staging. Instead, the Revised International Staging System (R-ISS) and R2-ISS are the universal standards of care. They stratify patients by tumor burden (beta-2 microglobulin, albumin), disease biology/proliferation (serum LDH), and cytogenetic risk profiles determined by interphase FISH on CD138-purified plasma cells.

t.label: Serum beta-2 microglobulin < 3.5 mg/L (low tumor burden)
Serum beta-2 microglobulin 3.5 to 5.4 mg/L (intermediate tumor burden)
Serum beta-2 microglobulin >= 5.5 mg/L (high tumor burden)

n.label: Serum albumin < 3.5 g/dL (compromised hepatic synthetic function / IL-6 suppression)

m.label: No high-risk cytogenetic abnormalities detected by iFISH; normal serum LDH
Presence of del(17p) and/or translocation t(4;14) and/or t(14;16)
Serum LDH above institutional upper limit of normal (>ULN)
Chromosome 1q21 copy number gain (3 copies) or amplification (>=4 copies) [R2-ISS criteria]

stageGroups.basis: ISS Stage I with standard-risk cytogenetics and normal LDH. 5-year OS ~82%, median PFS ~60 months.
Includes ISS Stage I with high-risk CA or high LDH, or ISS Stage II, or ISS Stage III with standard risk CA and normal LDH. 5-year OS ~62%, median PFS ~42 months.
ISS Stage III (B2M >=5.5 mg/L) combined with high-risk cytogenetics [del(17p), t(4;14), t(14;16)] OR elevated LDH (>ULN). 5-year OS ~40%, median PFS ~24 months.
R2-ISS high risk (score 1.5-2.5): co-occurrence of high-risk cytogenetics with 1q21 gain/amplification and elevated LDH. High unmet clinical need requiring quadruplet induction.

versions.regionalNodes: N/A for Multiple Myeloma. Assessment focuses on bone marrow plasma cell percentage and end-organ damage (CRAB criteria: Hypercalcemia, Renal insufficiency, Anemia, Bone lesions).
versions.histologicGrade: Plasma cell morphology (mature vs plasmablastic vs immature/pleomorphic).
versions.histopathologicTypes: Secretory myeloma (IgG, IgA, light chain only), non-secretory myeloma, plasma cell leukemia, smoldering multiple myeloma.
prognosticFactors: High-risk cytogenetics by iFISH: del(17p), t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), gain/amp(1q21)
Serum free light chain ratio (involved to uninvolved FLC >=100)
Bone marrow plasma cell percentage (>=60% defined as myeloma-defining event)
Circulating plasma cells (>=5% indicates aggressive plasma cell leukemia transition)
